title: THE SCUMM STICK · WALK TO dock
venue: private · after the machine in the pizza window · Box 32
logline: The last of the adventure's pages: the dock as a room, the lawn chair outlined, the ramp, the water, WALK TO dock, and the character — a small figure in plaid from behind, the only time the form draws him — halfway across the planks with the walk cycle's four frames drawn faintly behind him. The inventory strip empty again. Every object put back where the canon keeps it.

panels.composition: A page in a screen's 4:3 proportion: the scene fills the top two-thirds; below it a verb bar in a monospaced hand (LOOK AT · PICK UP · TALK TO · USE · OPEN · GIVE · WALK TO) with one verb marked; beneath that an inventory strip of small drawn objects: (empty). The sentence line above the verbs reads: WALK TO dock. Scene: a wooden dock with a lawn chair and a plank ramp outlined as hotspots, a small figure in plaid from behind halfway across the planks with four faint walk-cycle frames trailing behind him, the bay beyond.
